study type: Retrospective cohort study (secondary analysis of a registry)
cohort: The study included 156,572 deliveries of women from 2002 to 2008 from the Consortium on Safe Labor registry.
finding: A model was developed that identified independent pre-delivery risk factors for peripartum blood transfusion with a c-statistic of 0.71, showing strong internal validation.
gest_age: Gestational age was included as one of the salient predictors in the risk prediction model.
